name: steep-dip
description: The steep-dip mountain at three distances: the whole mountain from a kilometre, the flank whose beds dip with the slope from 100 m, the flank whose strike runs up the slope from 100 m, and a ledge on the flank whose beds dip into the slope from 10 m at eye height.

markers.name: far
markers.note: the whole mountain from a kilometre, toward the flank whose beds dip with the slope

markers.name: dip-slope
markers.note: 100 m from the flank whose beds dip with the slope

markers.name: strike
markers.note: 100 m from the flank whose strike runs up the slope

markers.name: near
markers.note: 10 m from a ledge on the flank whose beds dip into the slope, at eye height
